purpose: Find a small number of relevant adult creators, writers and educators who may genuinely value Mythical Void, then prepare individual introductions without bulk messaging.

audienceGroups.name: Indie and browser game creators
audienceGroups.reason: They can show authentic play and explain unusual systems to interested players.

audienceGroups.name: Creature, genetics and worldbuilding creators
audienceGroups.reason: The creature range and underlying system fit their existing subject matter.

audienceGroups.name: Family-game writers and adult reviewers
audienceGroups.reason: They can assess the game for parents and families without Mythical privately targeting children.

audienceGroups.name: STEM and space educators speaking to adults, teachers or families
audienceGroups.reason: The optional NASA-powered discovery layer gives them a truthful learning angle.

audienceGroups.name: Responsible creative-AI and small-studio writers
audienceGroups.reason: The father-and-son origin and human-led AI-first operating model offer a credible studio story.

criteria.name: Subject fit
criteria.question: Does Mythical Void clearly fit what this person already covers?

criteria.name: Audience fit
criteria.question: Is the audience made up of relevant players, adults, parents, educators or industry peers?

criteria.name: Evidence of thoughtful coverage
criteria.question: Do recent examples show care, disclosure and actual engagement with projects?

criteria.name: Reachability
criteria.question: Is there a public professional contact route intended for pitches?

criteria.name: Safety and reputation
criteria.question: Is there no material child-safety, harassment, hate, deception or undisclosed-promotion concern?

criteria.name: Learning value
criteria.question: Would a reply or piece of coverage teach the studio something useful even if reach is small?

automaticRejects: The recipient appears to be under 18 or the only route is a child's private account.
The contact details were scraped, guessed, purchased or obtained from a non-public source.
The outreach would require hiding AI involvement, paying without disclosure or making an unsupported claim.
The recipient has no visible connection to games, creatures, families, education, space, creative AI or independent studios.
The contact asks Mythical to move a child into private messaging or an unmoderated space.

messageTemplate.subject: A strange playable creature universe from an Irish father-and-son project
messageTemplate.body:
Hi [name],

I’m Kevin, the founder of Mythical Void. I’m reaching out because your work on [specific relevant piece] made me think this might genuinely fit your audience.

Mythical Void began as a father-and-son experiment with generative AI and imagination. It is now a free browser adventure with creature genetics, six restorable realms, story choices and optional NASA-powered discovery.

You can play it without a download or account: https://mythicalvoid.com/
The short fact sheet and clearly labelled press assets are here: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

If it is not a fit, no reply is needed and I won’t keep chasing.

Kevin
Mythical Void
messageTemplate.requiredTailoring: Replace the bracketed line with one precise, truthful reference to the recipient's work.

researchCandidates.name: Alpha Beta Gamer
researchCandidates.kind: Independent game site and YouTube channels
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official Game Submissions page publishes a submissions email and says free public builds may be considered for site or YouTube coverage.
researchCandidates.specificFit: Mythical Void is free, playable in-browser and visually unusual, which matches the outlet's explicit interest in playable independent games.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Lead with immediate browser play and authentic opening gameplay; mention the creature system only after proving the real build.

researchCandidates.name: Wholesome Games
researchCandidates.kind: Games showcase, creator network and publisher
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official site invites project submissions and offers creator, press and general routes; event forms open at specific times.
researchCandidates.specificFit: Restoring damaged worlds rather than destroying their guardians, creature care and the father-and-son origin may suit a hopeful-games audience.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Lead with restoration, wonder and the playable link. Do not force a cosy label or submit to a closed event form.

researchCandidates.name: Imirt — The Irish Game Makers Association
researchCandidates.kind: Irish games industry association and newsletter
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official newsletter page invites product launches and studio updates from the Irish game-development community through its named contribution route.
researchCandidates.specificFit: Mythical Void is an independent Irish studio with a playable game, unusual responsible-AI practice and a clear founder story.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Offer a concise Irish studio update: playable now, father-and-son origin, and one honest lesson from building an AI-first studio.

researchCandidates.name: Indie Games Developer
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official submission page accepts games and trailers for possible free website and magazine coverage, with no guarantee.
researchCandidates.specificFit: It is explicitly seeking independent games and allows a direct game submission once the project is sufficiently developed.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Submit only after the real gameplay trailer is finished; make browser play and the creature system the lead proof.

researchCandidates.name: IndieGameInn
researchCandidates.kind: Indie game showcase and YouTube publishing platform
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official site provides a submission form and rules for developer-made presentations considered for its site and YouTube channel.
researchCandidates.specificFit: It welcomes original independent games and explicitly describes how it reviews generative-AI use, making Mythical's human oversight and clear disclosures relevant.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Wait for a polished developer-commentary video using real gameplay, cleared music and labelled generated art.

researchCandidates.name: Phaser
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official Phaser documentation invites developers to share games through the Phaser forum, its public social account or email.
researchCandidates.specificFit: Mythical Void is a substantial Phaser 3 browser game with a portable distribution build, real gameplay captures and unusual creature-generation systems.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Ask whether the playable build is suitable for the Phaser showcase and lead with what was built in Phaser, not broad AI claims.

researchCandidates.name: Irish Tech News
researchCandidates.kind: Irish technology publication and contributor network
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official team page publishes a contribution email and lists coverage interests including space, science, STEAM, startups and technology.
researchCandidates.specificFit: The Irish father-and-son origin, working browser game, optional NASA discovery layer and human-led AI-first studio model form a relevant Irish technology story.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Offer a short founder story or interview about what a parent and nine-year-old imagined, what became real, and which decisions remain human.

researchCandidates.name: Technology.ie
researchCandidates.kind: Irish technology news and podcast site
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official submission page invites Irish technology product and company news through a named press-release address and states that coverage is not guaranteed.
researchCandidates.specificFit: Mythical Void is an Irish technology project with a live product, a family origin and a clear generative-AI studio angle.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Wait for a concise launch note with a real milestone, then lead with playable-now proof and the Irish founder story.

researchCandidates.name: Overlooked Games
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official review-request form says every submission is read and requires a public store link plus developer and contact details.
researchCandidates.specificFit: The site is expressly looking for overlooked independent games and buys selected games before giving an honest review.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Do not submit until the itch page and official studio contact route exist; then use the store page rather than presenting the main website as a store listing.

researchCandidates.name: Games for Change
researchCandidates.kind: Social-impact games network, festival and awards
researchCandidates.publicProfessionalRoute: The official awards page publishes annual criteria, fees, dates and a submission process for playable games with a clear learning or social-impact purpose.
researchCandidates.specificFit: Mythical Void may eventually fit learning, narrative or innovation themes through restoration, responsible technology and optional real-space discovery.
researchCandidates.suggestedAngle: Opportunity watch only: the 2026 deadline has passed, there is a fee, and the studio needs clearer learning aims and evidence before a future submission.
